description: BD CARTO® Equipement - Aérodrome - Orne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The CARTO® BD version 3.2 is the reference cartographic database. Used from the departmental scale (1: 50,000(e) at regional level (1: 250 000 (e), it describes all the information present in the metropolitan territory and the overseas departments. The different themes are: ADMINISTRATIVE; EQUIPMENT; DRESSING; HYDROGRAPHY; RESEAUFERRE; RESEAUROUTIER; TOPONYMY. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "BD CARTO® Equipment — Aerodrome — Orne" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include dénominations géographiques, géographie, Hydrographie, hydrographie, administration, organisation administrative. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
